 *           |------+------+------+------+------+------+------|       |------+------+------+------+------+------+------+------.
 *           |Shift |   Z  |   X  |   C  |   V  |   B  | Caps |       |  Del |   N  |   M  |   ,  |   .  |   /  |Shift | Fn   |

 *                                | LAlt | LGUI |  Fn  | Space|        |Space |  Fn | LGUI | LAlt |
